User walkthrough¶

Create a publishing company¶

  1. Open the home page and choose Create an account.

  2. Register as Editor with your own email and strong password.

  3. In My publishers, choose Create publisher and save the company profile. The creator becomes its first editor automatically.

  4. Have a colleague register as Journalist using their own account.

  5. Open the company and use Add an employee with that exact username.

Editors can edit their company’s profile and remove employees. The last active editor is protected from removal. Employees cannot manage unrelated companies.

Write and approve¶

  1. Sign in as the journalist, open Newsroom, then Write article.

  2. Enter a title and content, select the employer, and save the draft.

  3. Sign in as an assigned editor, open the story and select Approve / retry delivery. Authors cannot approve their own stories.

  4. The approved article appears in Latest news. Readers cannot see drafts.

  5. Editing an article creates a new revision and requires approval again.

Use separate browser profiles or log out between roles. These are real accounts you register locally; the installation does not seed mock users.

Subscriptions and newsletters¶

Readers register with the Reader role, then open Subscriptions to follow publishers and journalists. My subscriptions filters their approved feed. Editors and journalists can use Newsletters, curate approved articles and send the newsletter to subscribers. Console email is visible in terminal logs.

Approval delivery¶

Approval creates a durable revision snapshot and email recipient records before network calls. Delivery then emails readers and uses Requests to POST the event to /api/approved/. Retrying skips deliveries already marked successful. Network ambiguity can still cause duplicate remote acceptance; exactly-once delivery is not guaranteed. Use Approve / retry delivery after resolving a connection problem. Check pending emails and API status displayed by the application.
